description: Consensus is an AI-powered academic search engine over 220+ million peer-reviewed papers, with a REST API for search and evidence retrieval.
access_notes: API keys are self-generated from the account's API & MCP Dashboard with no approval step. Some capabilities (e.g. returning full-text passage chunks) are gated to paid plans.
api_notes: Single search endpoint returning titles, authors, journals, publication years, citation counts, and (on paid plans) full-text passage matches across 220M+ papers.
